questions.question: <div style=\"text-align:justify\">A gas present in a cylinder, fitted with a frictionless piston, expands against a constant pressure of 1 atm from a volume of 2 litre to a volume of 6 litre. In doing so, it absorbs 800 J heat from surroundings. The increase in internal energy (in Joule) of process is (1 atm.litre = 101.26 Joule)<br \/>$\n[Mark your answer to nearest integer]$<\/div>$\n$
questions.explanation:
**Explain Question: Find the increase in internal energy when a gas present in a cylinder, fitted with a frictionless piston, expands against a constant pressure of 1 atm from a volume of 2 litre to a volume of 6 litre. In doing so, it absorbs 800 J heat from surroundings
$ $**Concept: ΔU = q + w
$ $**Solution:
$ Work$ is done against constant pressure and thus irreversible given.
$ W$ = –P.ΔV = –1 × (6 – 2) atm litre = –405.04 joule.
$ For$ first law
$ q$ = ΔE – W
$ $ΔE = q + w = 800 – 405.04 = 394.95 Joule
